objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, invalidated, reactivated, and displayed to authorized readers.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Consecutive number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed in the document by TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a document and used to define templates, extended validity period, and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable for creating new document objects and used for template-based editing.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create new documents or to add objects to a document.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties of a document where standardized and customer-specific metadata, authorizations, references, IT applications, relevant companies, areas of validity, workflow participants, and distribution settings are maintained.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of document attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute used to link documents to Master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example that can be linked with documents and maintained as an attribute.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company attribute maintained via document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity attribute maintained via document properties.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked and for process-specific filing.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing source format used by the editing client to open a document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Format to which saved documents are automatically converted and displayed on the web.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader assignment, authorization groups, distribution, dashboards, and role-based selection lists.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user assigned to author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translation, distribution, or workflow participation.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or assignment for users who can view approved documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered person who signs document creation and receives read and write permissions when assigned.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with personal change rights on a document but no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for the document and content who decides whether a document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object that can supplement a document and is released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with the main document, versioned, and archived with the next version of the main document when marked for archiving.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as additional information or equipment for describing documents in more detail.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that belongs to a document and can be created, managed, scheduled, edited, and completed.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported processing used for release, validity extension, AKS, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation approval.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during workflow-supported processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification used to inform workflow users, authors, readers, distribution recipients, and creators of proposals.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate documents and processed automatically by workflow.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents after other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created in a folder to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document that assigns User Groups and persons for distribution, read authorization, dashboards, e-mail notification, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons and User Groups assigned to distribution for acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled using distribution groups and listing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, workflow status, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a document checked and released with workflow support and visible in the corresponding login language after release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the document templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: open_document_property_editing
evts.description: Open the properties editing of the document after attachment of an object.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata for the document.

evts.name: maintain_attribute
evts.description: Maintain attributes such as references, IT applications, relevant companies, or areas of validity via document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF with system support.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version as a PDF on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations through a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a person as author and provide read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign personal change rights through the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign a reviewer and provide read and write permissions.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign a releaser and provide read and write permissions.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an Attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete review tasks for the document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Assigned releasers complete release tasks and finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Inform involved users of workflow task status and existence or other process notifications by e-mail.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature documented for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the Valid until date by the default value.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after declaring additional validity or release of a revised version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate validity extension process when a new revised version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing the request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_aks_request
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the AKS process.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force so last valid approved version receives Out of force status and rights are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalid documents and their attachments by withdrawal of authorizations.

evts.name: delete_archived_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the reactivation workflow after a request for reactivation is created.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document and setting authorizations from maintained attributes.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons on the Distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release from persons and users of User Groups assigned for acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgements_complete
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards using distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: display_language_version
evts.description: Make released language version visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the client for a local addition and create a reference to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created using a selected template.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
Document properties are used to maintain attributes, metadata, authorizations, workflow participants, and distribution settings for a document.
Metadata can be maintained via document properties.
Attributes and metadata are grouped into categories.
References are maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.
IT applications can be maintained in document properties and linked with documents.
Relevant companies can be maintained for a document.
Areas of validity can be maintained for a document.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with Master data.
The editing client opens a document based on the existing source format.
A saved document is converted to PDF and displayed on the web.
Reader authorizations are assigned via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.
Readers can view approved documents and dependent objects when authorized.
The creator is automatically confirmed in the Author field and the registered author signs creation.
Co-authors can be assigned personal change rights for a document.
Reviewers maintained in the attributes are assigned to review a document.
Releasers maintained in the attributes are assigned to release a document.
Assignment of participants for checking and releasing translation is carried out in document properties.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments are controlled documents associated with a main document and released with it.
Additional information and Equippments can be added to each document.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Document approval, validity extension, AKS, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation are workflow-supported.
Workflow participants complete workflow tasks.
Workflow tasks are completed with electronic signatures where stated.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version and can be printed as document content.
Users involved in workflow tasks are informed by e-mail notifications.
The request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.
Users in the Archive group still have read access to archived documents.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
A Distribution list is maintained in the cockpit for the document.
User Groups assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Persons assigned to Distribution receive read authorization and notifications or acknowledgement tasks.
Acknowledgements are requested and documented for released document versions.
Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.
Relevant documents are assigned in the dashboard for users included in assigned distribution groups.
Reports provide evaluations of documents stored in the system.
The report lists all acknowledgements depending on status.
Translated language versions of released documents are checked, released, and displayed.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
